$comment: Translation table used by scripts/Sync-ClaudePlugins.ps1 to convert Copilot agent
frontmatter into Claude Code subagent frontmatter.
'tools' maps a Copilot/VS Code tool id to zero or more Claude Code tool names.
An empty array means the capability has no Claude equivalent and is dropped;
the reason is recorded in 'dropReasons' and emitted as a comment in the generated agent.
'mcpPrefixes' matches tool ids by prefix and maps them to the MCP server that provides
them. The server must be declared in the plugin's own manifest. The generator turns it
into Claude MCP server-level patterns, which grant every tool from that server:
mcp__plugin_<plugin>_<server>   the plugin-provided server, namespaced by its plugin
mcp__<server>                   the same server registered directly in a .mcp.json
Both are emitted because the prefix depends on how the server was registered, and a
'tools' allowlist is matched against the exact runtime names. Granting the server rather
than a list of tool names also keeps the allowlist working when the server renames its
tools - which is not hypothetical: the Aspire MCP server's get_* tools became list_*.
This file is hand-maintained. When a new Copilot tool id appears in an agent, the
generator fails with 'unmapped tool id' rather than guessing - add the mapping here.
$alwaysIncludeComment: Copilot exposes plugin skills to agents implicitly; Claude requires the Skill tool to be listed.
$mcpPrefixesComment: The Aspire MCP server renamed its query tools from get_* to list_* (and dropped metrics
entirely). Both spellings are mapped: the current list_* names, and the get_* names that
an older Aspire CLI still exposes. Neither host errors on an id it cannot resolve, so an
agent may declare both and keep working across CLI versions.

dropReasons.vscode/memory: VS Code workspace memory has no Claude Code equivalent; Claude uses CLAUDE.md and the memory directory instead.
dropReasons.extensions_manage: Copilot CLI extension management API; no Claude Code equivalent.
dropReasons.extensions_reload: Copilot CLI extension management API; no Claude Code equivalent.
dropReasons.list_canvas_capabilities: Copilot canvas extension API; no Claude Code equivalent (nearest analogue is Artifact).
dropReasons.open_canvas: Copilot canvas extension API; no Claude Code equivalent (nearest analogue is Artifact).
dropReasons.invoke_canvas_action: Copilot canvas extension API; no Claude Code equivalent (nearest analogue is Artifact).

$modelsComment: Copilot pins concrete model names; Claude Code takes an alias (opus/sonnet/haiku/fable),
a full model id, or 'inherit'. GPT-5.3-Codex was chosen in the Copilot agents as the
strong coding model, so it maps to 'opus'. Agents with no model pin get no model field,
